name: Lebensmittelbetriebe und Hygienebewertungen Westminster

notes: 5779 includes shops, hotels and other food establishments, not only restaurants. Countrywide FSA stock is broader and is not added to the Westminster subset. Some private addresses and coordinates are withheld. Use current rating or show update date; official logos and rating imagery have additional restrictions. Free official search is an established competitor; no ranking advantage demonstrated.

name: Forschungsnahe Organisationen Deutschland

notes: 5878 is directly observed API facet output, not a downloaded German corpus. The global response contains mixed organisation types; these are not 5878 universities or commercial laboratories. GeoNames locations can represent city centres, not entrances or street addresses. Dump includes inactive and withdrawn records unless explicitly filtered. Use a full release for exhaustive country selection; filter-only pagination can miss or repeat records.

name: Historischer Denkmalatlas Frankreich
